verdict.rationale: YYLO accepts natural-language task descriptions and prompts that it passes to coding agents (e.g. `yylo init --task "..."`, `yy pi 'Summarize this repository...'`). It can also ingest Slack messages and GitHub issues as work. YYLO Skills let an agent steer and operate YYLO and Ledger, but the product itself is driven by structured CLI subcommands, not a natural-language command interface. missing for 10: direct natural-language control of YYLO's own operations (task/merge/ledger) without explicit subcommands, documented end-to-end agent-driven operation via skills, independent or hands-on corroboration.
